info.title: Task API
info.description: The task API every task service in this repository serves. It is held to the contract cases beside it, scripts/contract/tasks-api.json, and to the task rules in scripts/rules/task-rules.json, by checkSpec in scripts/check-contract.mjs: every response documented here is exercised by a case, every case on a documented operation answers with a status documented here, and the schemas state the same fields, statuses and title length. A method a path does not list is answered 405 with an Allow header naming the methods it does list (HEAD wherever GET is), and a path not listed here 404, both with an Error body. Every response carries the RequestId header, and every request is logged once as one JSON line; the contract check reads both.

get.summary: Report that the service is up

post.summary: Create a task in the todo status

422.description: The title is empty once trimmed, or longer than the rules allow

400.description: The id is not a valid path segment, such as a malformed percent-escape

patch.summary: Move a task to another status

409.description: The rules do not allow this move from the task's status, staying put included

422.description: The status is missing, null, or not one of the statuses

RequestId.description: The X-Request-Id the caller sent when it matches the pattern, otherwise a new one. The same id is in the request's log line.

BadRequest.description: The body is not one UTF-8 JSON object of the documented fields, spelled exactly and of the documented types, or is over the size limit

title.description: Trimmed; the length is counted in characters (code points), not bytes

Timestamp.description: UTC, to the millisecond, as every task service writes it

title.description: Trimmed before it is checked; a missing or null title reads as empty, and is refused with 422, and a value that is not a string with 400

status.description: One of the statuses; any other string, null or a missing status is refused with 422, and a value that is not a string with 400
